ConnectionStrings.DevConnection: *** STORED IN USER SECRETS - Run 'dotnet user-secrets list' to view ***
ConnectionStrings.ProdConnection: *** CONFIGURE IN PRODUCTION SECRETS MANAGER (Azure Key Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, etc.) ***

_SecretManagementInfo.Development: Connection strings are stored in .NET User Secrets. To configure: 'dotnet user-secrets set ConnectionStrings:DevConnection <your-connection-string>'
_SecretManagementInfo.Production: Connection strings MUST be stored in a secure secrets management service such as Azure Key Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, or HashiCorp Vault. DO NOT hardcode credentials in appsettings.json or appsettings.Production.json
